about.title: Who are we?
about.subtitle: Discover the history, legal status, vision, mission, and governance of AGENCE CONGOLAISE DE PROMOTION DES DROITS DES PERSONNES HANDICAPEES-ACPDPH.
about.history_text: AGENCE CONGOLAISE DE PROMOTION DES DROITS DES PERSONNES HANDICAPEES-ACPDPH is a recognized Non-Governmental Organization in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Headquartered in Beni (North Kivu), its scope covers the national territory alongside international partnerships.
about.vision_text: To build a just, inclusive, and united Congolese society where every person with disabilities fully enjoys fundamental rights, equal access to opportunities, and active community participation.
about.mission_text: To promote, protect, and defend the rights of persons with disabilities by ensuring accessibility, inclusive education, health, rehabilitation, and socio-economic empowerment.
about.ag_desc: Supreme governing body uniting founding and active members to set key strategic directions.
about.ca_desc: Supervisory body guaranteeing sound governance, transparency, and program oversight.
about.bureau_desc: Operational coordination team managing technical project monitoring, partnerships, and advocacy.
about.direction_desc: Daily management of field operations in Beni and surrounding intervention territories.
